title: Agreement and reference
summary: Control subject–verb agreement and pronoun reference in complex sentences.

provenance.authored_by: Codex English V3-B Sprint breadth milestone

sections.title: Find the controller
content: Underline the finite verb, then identify the head subject rather than the closest noun. Circle every pronoun and its intended antecedent.

sections.title: Apply two control checks
content: Of-phrases do not normally control the verb; each and everyone are singular; distinct subjects joined by and are plural.
Use a pronoun only when one clear antecedent matches number and meaning.

sections.title: Remove distractors
content: ‘The collection of maps is locked’ agrees with collection, not maps. ‘When Sara returned the laptop, Mei noticed its cracked screen’ names both important referents.

sections.title: Repair agreement and reference
content: Strip interrupting phrases to test agreement, then replace any pronoun that could point to two nouns.

sections.title: Run a two-pass edit
content: First check every finite verb against its head subject. Then trace every pronoun back to one unambiguous antecedent.

sections.title: Name the control failure
content: Use agreement control for the wrong subject or number; use option trap when a smooth sentence still leaves ambiguity.

sections.title: Control five sentences
content: Choose grammatically controlled and unambiguous versions before feedback.
